reason: The README clearly describes a plugin for analyzing local images through Gemini and GLM APIs, including image description, OCR, visual question answering, and browser image upload support.

summaries.zh: 通过 Gemini 或 GLM 视觉 API 为文本模型提供本地图片描述、OCR 和视觉问答能力。
summaries.en: Provides local image description, OCR, and visual question answering for text-only models through Gemini or GLM vision APIs.

capabilities: Reads local image files for analysis
Uploads image data to Gemini or GLM vision APIs
Performs image description, OCR, and visual question answering
Stores provider API keys in the DSH credentials store
Provides a local HTTP route for browser image uploads
